items.statement: The investigation reports converged stationary-point calculations and frequency evidence, with minima and any transition structure distinguished by imaginary-frequency count and cleavage-mode interpretation.
items.expected: Auditable convergence and frequency evidence is provided for each advanced state; the transition candidate, if claimed, has one cleavage-relevant imaginary mode.

items.statement: Reaction free energy is assembled from state free energies with an explicitly stated thermochemical convention and components.
items.expected: The report identifies electronic, thermal, standard-state and solvation terms and shows how they form ΔG.

items.statement: The reported Reaction 3 Gibbs energy is −34.7 kcal/mol for the paper's convention.
The disulfide-cleavage calculation supports a spontaneous regeneration interpretation within the molecular model, not a complete proof of the heterogeneous CPRS surface mechanism.
items.expected: Conclusion states thermodynamic favorability under the submitted convention and explicitly limits interpretation to the molecular model.
